# Chronova

> Chronova is an advanced developer productivity analytics platform that tracks coding activity through heartbeat monitoring, integrates with WakaTime, and provides comprehensive insights into coding patterns, time allocation, and productivity metrics.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://chronova.dev/docs): Everything you need to connect WakaTime-compatible tooling to Chronova
- [API Reference](https://chronova.dev/api-reference): Chronova exposes a modern JSON API, fully compatible with existing WakaTime tooling
- [Downloads](https://chronova.dev/downloads): Mobile apps and CLI clients
- [Privacy Policy](https://chronova.dev/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling practices
- [Terms of Service](https://chronova.dev/terms): Terms of service and usage agreement
- [Imprint](https://chronova.dev/imprint): Legal imprint and contact information

## API

- [API v1 Endpoints](https://chronova.dev/api-reference): Complete API reference with authentication, endpoints, and examples
- [Authentication Guide](https://chronova.dev/api-reference#auth): API keys, session tokens, and OAuth flows
- [Rate Limits](https://chronova.dev/api-reference#limits): Throughput limits and best practices
- [WakaTime Compatibility](https://chronova.dev/api-reference#compat): Drop-in endpoints for WakaTime CLI and plugins

## Tools

- [Chronova CLI](https://chronova.dev/docs): Command-line interface with WakaTime compatibility
- [MCP Server](https://chronova.dev/docs): Model Context Protocol server for AI coding assistants
- [Editor Plugins](https://chronova.dev/docs): VS Code, JetBrains, Vim/Neovim, Sublime Text integrations
- [GitHub Integration](https://chronova.dev/api-reference#github): Sync repositories and correlate commits with heartbeats

## Optional

- [Source Code](https://github.com/nx-solutions-ug/chronova): Main Chronova repository
- [CLI Source](https://github.com/nx-solutions-ug/chronova-cli): Chronova CLI source code
- [MCP Server Source](https://github.com/nx-solutions-ug/chronova-mcp): MCP server source code
- [Android App](https://github.com/nx-solutions-ug/chronova-android): Android app source code
